title: ASCC registry entity
description: v1alpha1. One registry entity: the common envelope (data contracts section 2.1) and, under spec, the fields of its type (sections 2.2, 2.3 and 2.5). The type field selects the id prefix, the lifecycle values and the spec. Unknown fields are refused except inside a finding's evidence. A credential appears as a reference, a digest or a public key; the schema can't stop a secret being typed into free text.

id.description: Type-prefixed ULID; the prefix is set by type.

owner.description: IdP subject, usr:<issuer-hash>:<sub>. Null until one is assigned.

coverage.description: Computed from evidence, never set by a writer.

plugin_id.description: Recorded on a write made through the plugin host.

connector_id.description: Recorded on a write made through the plugin host.

allOf.$comment: FR-CON-16: an agent a vendor hosts is observed at best.

hosting.description: A vendor_hosted agent is never enforced.

egress_hosts.description: Lowercase DNS names: no scheme, port, userinfo, path, wildcard or IP literal.

public_key_jwk.description: The instance's public key. Closed, so a private member such as d is refused.

upstream_url.description: No userinfo, query string or fragment, the places a URL carries a credential.

arg_constraints.description: Argument name to its constraint, such as in or matches.

credential_ref_spec.description: Where a credential lives, never its value.

principal.description: An agent, a group or a user.
